data_source: YouTube Data API v3 (videos.list + channels.list across 20+ benchmark channels) + yt-dlp spoken transcript & WPM extraction

global_findings.hook_0_to_2s_rule: 85% of viewers decide to stay or swipe within 0.0s-1.8s. Scene 1 narration MUST be 6-10 words (1.6s-2.2s) using 1 of the 4 Psychological-Visual Hook Archetypes, accompanied by a 3-beat rapid visual cut at 1.12s and 2.24s (cuts_first_3s >= 2).
global_findings.golden_separation_title_vs_hook: Title MUST explicitly name the high-search-volume entities + concrete physical metric/confrontation for YT_SEARCH ('[Entity A] vs [Entity B]: [Extreme Metric]'). Scene 1 (0.0s) MUST NEVER repeat the Title verbatim or spoil the final metric — save hard numbers for Act 2 (Scenes 2-3) and Act 3 (Scene 4 Mid-Video Twist).
global_findings.visual_deictic_anchoring: Million-view Shorts lock the viewer's eye at 0.0s using deictic micro-observation pointers ('Look closely at...', 'Watch this suspect's hands...', 'Olhe bem para...', 'O último erro desse...') paired with immediate physical motion on screen.
global_findings.zero_literary_fluff: Top 1M-92M view Shorts use Grade-5 conversational language at 168-220 WPM (Zack D. Films / Casual Geographic / Você Sabia? / Charisma on Command / HistoryMarche / GeoBeats Animals style), never slow poetic metaphors or textbook definitions.
global_findings.engagement_architecture: Embed a Counterfactual 50/50 Debate Question (e.g., 2v1 escalation, terrain flip, or next opponent — NEVER asking what the video already answered and ZERO 'Subscribe/Inscreva-se' spam) in Pinned/Author Comment and Description Line 1.

en-US.visual_cut_rhythm: 3-beat rapid cut in Scene 1 (Beat 1A: 0.00s-1.12s Shock Action -> Beat 1B: 1.12s-2.24s Flipped Tight Focal Crop -> Beat 1C: 2.24s-end), then 3.2s-4.5s per body scene.
hook_archetypes: Archetype 1 — Visual Micro-Observation ('Look closely at the circular scars on this whale's head.' / 'What looks like a dead branch in this river just opened its eyes.')
Archetype 2 — Real-Life Spoken Trap / Backhanded Insult (Psychology — Charisma on Command 9.78M Formula: '"You actually look good today" is not a compliment—watch their eyes next.')

Archetype 3 — The Fatal Mistake / In Medias Res Clash (Wildlife & History — HistoryMarche 5.33M Formula: 'This caiman's last mistake was climbing onto this riverbank alone.' / 'The Roman infantry pushed forward, walking straight into Hannibal's trap.')
Archetype 4 — Time-Anchored Emotional Rescue Hook (Rescue — GeoBeats Animals 2.77M Formula: 'He spent ten years completely alone until one stranger opened his cage.')
anti_patterns_causing_high_swipe: Repeating the title's exact number or spoiling the winner at 0.0s
Abstract literary metaphors ('That sweet compliment is a loaded weapon', 'A silent cage of the mind')
Slow 14-18 word opening sentences or 0 visual cuts in the first 3 seconds (cuts_first_3s = 0)
Rhetorical Yes/No questions ('Did you know...?', 'Have you ever wondered...?')

pt-BR.reading_grade_level: Coloquial Brasileiro Vibrante, Direto e Hiper-Visual (Estilo Você Sabia? / Manual do Mundo / Richard Rasmussen)
pt-BR.visual_cut_rhythm: Corte triplo rápido na Cena 1 (0.00s-1.12s Choque Físico -> 1.12s-2.24s Close-up Invertido -> 2.24s-fim), mantendo APV > 100%.
hook_archetypes: Arquétipo 1 — Apontamento Micro-Visual ('Olhe bem para essas marcas redondas na pele desse cachalote.' / 'O que parece um tronco podre nessa água rasa acabou de abrir os olhos.')
Arquétipo 2 — O Último Erro / Predador Vira Presa ('O último erro desse jacaré foi subir nesse barranco sem olhar para cima.')
Arquétipo 3 — Simulação de Sobrevivência em 2ª Pessoa ('Se você vir ondas quadradas na praia, saia da água imediatamente.')
Arquétipo 4 — Quebra de Expectativa / Inversão de Força ('Seis leões famintos cercaram esse pequeno animal, mas os leões estão fugindo.')
anti_patterns_causing_high_swipe: Repetir o título palavra por palavra ou entregar o número exato já no segundo 0,0s
Introduções lentas tipo documentário de TV ('O oceano é um lugar cheio de mistérios...')
Português de Portugal formal em vez de português brasileiro natural

psychology.winning_hook_blueprint: Open Scene 1 (0.0s, 6-10 words) with a real-life spoken manipulation trap in quotes, a forensic interrogation micro-behavior pointer ('Watch this suspect's hands the second the detective mentions the car'), or an everyday social attack—NEVER a dry textbook definition. Deliver the neurological/FBI mechanism in Scenes 2-3, flip expectations at Scene 4 (15s Twist), and give a concrete 2-step counter-move in Scenes 5-7.

wildlife_predators.winning_hook_blueprint: Name both species + extreme metric in the Title ('[Entity A] vs [Entity B]: [Extreme Metric]') for YT_SEARCH discovery. In Scene 1 (0.0s, 6-10 words), NEVER repeat the title's PSI/speed statistic: open with a Visual Micro-Observation, Fatal Mistake, or Role Reversal ('This caiman's last mistake was climbing onto this riverbank alone.' / 'O último erro desse jacaré foi subir nesse barranco sem olhar para cima.'), then unleash Entity A's weapon in Scenes 2-3 and Entity B's counter-mechanism twist in Scene 4.

alternate_history.winning_hook_blueprint: Frame Title around the exact historical empire/commander/catastrophe + tactical question or metric (HistoryMarche / Zack D. Films style). animal_rescue.winning_hook_blueprint: ALWAYS use warm spoken storytelling narration (166-190 WPM, NEVER music-only montage). Open Scene 1 (0.0s, 6-10 words) with the specific location/duration of abandonment + emotional state ('Found shivering behind a train station, this puppy refused to move.' / 'He spent ten years completely alone inside a concrete cage.'), show the first warm meal/bed in Scenes 2-3, the exact second trust was won in Scene 4 ('Within five minutes indoors, watch how he reacted'), and the joyful healthy transformation in Scenes 5-7.
